verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway documents plugins for request/response transformations on proxied traffic, which covers the 'massage data' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows user-authored pre-request or post-response scripts, or chaining one request's output into another. Plugin extensibility is a building block, and Event Hook Lua lambdas fire on entity changes rather than requests, so neither earns credit. Missing for 10: documented pre-request/post-response scripting, request chaining with variable passing, scripting docs or examples, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script pre-request and post-response logic to chain requests and massage data

citations.quote: Plugins for enforcing traffic controls, rate limiting, req/res transformations, logging, monitoring
